This project was performed by IDOM in partnership with Florida Atlantic University’s (FAU) Southeast National Marine Renewable Energy Center (SNMREC). The MTV is an at-sea test platform for turbines that extract energy from marine currents (found in the open ocean, tides, or rivers). It will allow marine energy developers to test turbines affordably, expediently, and flexibly in various U.S. locations and environmental conditions. The MTV’s design allows for connecting and testing different turbine configurations: floating, bottom-mounted, platform- mounted, and towed (up to 8 m in diameter).
